title: CineDramas Brand Manifest
description: Per-brand build + runtime configuration. One manifest per brand under brands/<variant>/manifest.json.

appName.description: Display name shown under the app icon (store + home screen).

slug.description: Expo slug + deep-link scheme. Lowercase, digits, hyphens.

tenantId.description: Tenant this build serves. Must match a row in the tenants table.

bundleId.description: Reverse-DNS iOS bundle identifier, e.g. com.cinedramas.dev.

supabaseUrl.description: Supabase project URL for this brand's environment.

supabaseAnonKey.description: Supabase anon (publishable) key. Safe to ship in the client.

revenuecatApiKey.description: RevenueCat public SDK key. May be empty until billing is enabled.

sentryDsn.description: Sentry DSN. May be empty to disable crash reporting for this brand.

sentryProject.description: Sentry project slug for source-map upload at build time.
